verdict.rationale: DeepInfra docs confirm you can deploy your own fine-tuned LLM weights on dedicated GPU instances for serving, and rent GPU clusters with SSH access for training, which together could satisfy fine-tune+serve on the same platform. However, there is no evidence of a managed, turnkey fine-tuning job/API (e.g., submit training data against a supported base model) analogous to OpenAI's fine-tuning service — training appears to be DIY via raw GPU rental rather than an integrated fine-tune-then-serve pipeline. Missing for 10: a documented fine-tuning API/job workflow, evidence of supported base models for fine-tuning, and confirmation that fine-tuned outputs auto-integrate into the serving catalog.
